rows.name: New Network ACL Entry Added
rows.description: Detects that network ACL entries have been added to a route table which could indicate that new attack vectors have been opened up in the AWS account.
rows.logic:
condition: selection
selection:
  eventName: CreateNetworkAclEntry
  eventSource: ec2.amazonaws.com

rows.name: Potential Malicious Usage of CloudTrail System Manager
rows.description: Detect when System Manager successfully executes commands against an instance.
rows.logic:
condition: selection_event and 1 of selection_status_*
selection_event:
  eventName: SendCommand
  eventSource: ssm.amazonaws.com
selection_status_null:
  errorCode: null
selection_status_success:
  errorCode: Success

rows.name: AWS ElastiCache Security Group Modified or Deleted
rows.description: Identifies when an ElastiCache security group has been modified or deleted.
rows.logic:
condition: selection
selection:
  eventName:
  - DeleteCacheSecurityGroup
  - AuthorizeCacheSecurityGroupIngress
  - RevokeCacheSecurityGroupIngress
  - AuthorizeCacheSecurityGroupEgress
  - RevokeCacheSecurityGroupEgress
  eventSource: elasticache.amazonaws.com

rows.name: AWS RDS Master Password Change
rows.description: Detects the change of database master password. It may be a part of data exfiltration.
rows.logic:
condition: selection_source
selection_source:
  eventName: ModifyDBInstance
  eventSource: rds.amazonaws.com
  responseElements.pendingModifiedValues.masterUserPassword|contains: '*'

rows.name: JexBoss Command Sequence
rows.description: Detects suspicious command sequence that JexBoss
rows.logic:
condition: keywords
keywords:
  '|all':
  - bash -c /bin/bash
  - '&/dev/tcp/'

rows.name: Linux Setuid Capability Set on a Binary via Setcap Utility
rows.description:
Detects the use of the 'setcap' utility to set the 'setuid' capability (cap_setuid) on a binary file.
This capability allows a non privileged process to make arbitrary manipulations of user IDs (UIDs), including setting its current UID to a value that would otherwise be restricted (i.e. UID 0, the root user).
This behavior can be used by adversaries to backdoor a binary in order to escalate privileges again in the future if needed.
rows.logic:
condition: selection
selection:
  CommandLine|contains: cap_setuid
  Image|endswith: /setcap

rows.name: Install Root Certificate
rows.description: Detects installation of new certificate on the system which attackers may use to avoid warnings when connecting to controlled web servers or C2s
rows.logic:
condition: selection
selection:
  Image|endswith:
  - /update-ca-certificates
  - /update-ca-trust

rows.name: Potential Discovery Activity Using Find - Linux
rows.description: Detects usage of "find" binary in a suspicious manner to perform discovery
rows.logic:
condition: selection
selection:
  CommandLine|contains:
  - -perm -4000
  - -perm -2000
  - -perm 0777
  - -perm -222
  - -perm -o w
  - -perm -o x
  - -perm -u=s
  - -perm -g=s
  Image|endswith: /find

rows.name: FortiGate - VPN SSL Settings Modified
rows.description:
Detects the modification of VPN SSL Settings (for example, the modification of authentication rules).
This behavior was observed in pair with the addition of a VPN SSL Web Portal.
rows.logic:
condition: selection
selection:
  action: Edit
  cfgpath: vpn.ssl.settings

rows.name: Service Installation in Suspicious Folder
rows.description: Detects service installation in suspicious folder appdata
rows.logic:
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_optional_*
filter_optional_zoom:

selection:

rows.name: Mimikatz Use
rows.description: This method detects mimikatz keywords in different Eventlogs (some of them only appear in older Mimikatz version that are however still used by different threat groups)
rows.logic:
condition: keywords and not filter
filter:
  EventID: 15
keywords:
- dpapi::masterkey
- eo.oe.kiwi
- event::clear
- event::drop
- gentilkiwi.com
- kerberos::golden
- kerberos::ptc
- kerberos::ptt
- kerberos::tgt
- Kiwi Legit Printer
- 'lsadump::'
- mimidrv.sys
- \mimilib.dll
- misc::printnightmare
- misc::shadowcopies
- misc::skeleton
- privilege::backup
- privilege::debug
- privilege::driver
- 'sekurlsa::'

rows.name: Windows Defender Configuration Changes
rows.description: Detects suspicious changes to the Windows Defender configuration
rows.logic:
condition: selection
selection:
  EventID: 5007
  NewValue|contains:
  - '\Windows Defender\DisableAntiSpyware '
  - '\Windows Defender\Scan\DisableRemovableDriveScanning '
  - '\Windows Defender\Scan\DisableScanningMappedNetworkDrivesForFullScan '
  - '\Windows Defender\SpyNet\DisableBlockAtFirstSeen '
  - '\Real-Time Protection\SpyNetReporting '

rows.name: DNS Query To Remote Access Software Domain From Non-Browser App
rows.description:
An adversary may use legitimate desktop support and remote access software, such as Team Viewer, Go2Assist, LogMein, AmmyyAdmin, etc, to establish an interactive command and control channel to target systems within networks.
These services are commonly used as legitimate technical support software, and may be allowed by application control within a target environment.
Remote access tools like VNC, Ammyy, and Teamviewer are used frequently when compared with other legitimate software commonly used by adversaries. (Citation: Symantec Living off the Land)
rows.logic:
condition: 1 of selection_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*
filter_optional_avant:
  Image|endswith: \avant.exe
  Image|startswith:
  - C:\Program Files (x86)\Avant Browser\
  - C:\Program Files\Avant Browser\
filter_optional_brave:
  Image|endswith: \brave.exe
  Image|startswith: C:\Program Files\BraveSoftware\

- Image|endswith: \WindowsApps\MicrosoftEdge.exe
- Image:
  - C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe
  - C:\Program Files\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe
filter_optional_edge_2:

  - \msedge.exe
  - \msedgewebview2.exe
  Image|startswith:
  - C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\EdgeCore\

filter_optional_falkon:

filter_optional_firefox:

condition: selection
selection:

  - \wscript.exe

  - :\Perflogs\
  - :\ProgramData\
  - :\Temp\
  - :\Tmp\
  - :\Users\
  - :\Windows\Temp\
  - \AppData\Local\Temp
  - \AppData\Roaming\Temp

  - ' -NoP -NonI -W Hidden -enc '

rows.name: HackTool - Potential Impacket Lateral Movement Activity
rows.description: Detects wmiexec/dcomexec/atexec/smbexec from Impacket framework
rows.logic:

selection_atexec:
  CommandLine|contains|all:
  - cmd.exe
  - /C
  - Windows\Temp\
  - '&1'

  - /Q
  - /c
  - \\\\127.0.0.1\\

  - \wmiprvse.exe
  - \mmc.exe

rows.name: Suspicious Active Directory Database Snapshot Via ADExplorer
rows.description: Detects the execution of Sysinternals ADExplorer with the "-snapshot" flag in order to save a local copy of the active directory database to a suspicious directory. This can be used by attackers to extract data for Bloodhound, usernames for password spraying or use the meta data for social engineering. The snapshot doesn't contain password hashes but there have been cases, where administrators put passwords in the comment field.
rows.logic:
condition: all of selection_*
selection_flag:
  CommandLine|contains: snapshot
selection_img:
- Image|endswith:
  - \ADExp.exe
  - \ADExplorer.exe
  - \ADExplorer64.exe
  - \ADExplorer64a.exe
- OriginalFileName: AdExp
- Description: Active Directory Editor
- Product: Sysinternals ADExplorer
selection_paths:
  CommandLine|contains:
  - \Downloads\
  - \Users\Public\
  - \AppData\
  - \Windows\Temp\

rows.name: Psexec Execution
rows.description: Detects user accept agreement execution in psexec commandline
rows.logic:
condition: selection
selection:
- Image|endswith: \psexec.exe
- OriginalFileName: psexec.c

rows.name: Use of UltraVNC Remote Access Software
rows.description: An adversary may use legitimate desktop support and remote access software,to establish an interactive command and control channel to target systems within networks
rows.logic:

selection:
- Description: VNCViewer
- Product: UltraVNC VNCViewer
- Company: UltraVNC
- OriginalFileName: VNCViewer.exe

rows.name: CurrentControlSet Autorun Keys Modification
rows.description: Detects modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry.
rows.logic:
condition: all of system_control_* and not 1 of filter_*
filter_cutepdf:
  Details:
  - cpwmon64_v40.dll
  - CutePDF Writer
  Image: C:\Windows\System32\spoolsv.exe
  TargetObject|contains: \Print\Monitors\CutePDF Writer Monitor
filter_empty:
  Details: (Empty)
filter_onenote:
  Image: C:\Windows\System32\spoolsv.exe
  TargetObject|contains: Print\Monitors\Appmon\Ports\Microsoft.Office.OneNote_
  User|contains:
  - AUTHORI
  - AUTORI
filter_poqexec:
  Image: C:\Windows\System32\poqexec.exe
  TargetObject|endswith: \NetworkProvider\Order\ProviderOrder
filter_realvnc:
  Details: VNCpm.dll
  Image: C:\Windows\System32\spoolsv.exe
  TargetObject|endswith: \Print\Monitors\MONVNC\Driver
system_control_base:
  TargetObject|contains: \SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control
system_control_keys:
  TargetObject|contains:
  - \Terminal Server\WinStations\RDP-Tcp\InitialProgram
  - \Terminal Server\Wds\rdpwd\StartupPrograms
  - \SecurityProviders\SecurityProviders
  - \SafeBoot\AlternateShell
  - \Print\Providers
  - \Print\Monitors
  - \NetworkProvider\Order
  - \Lsa\Notification Packages
  - \Lsa\Authentication Packages
  - \BootVerificationProgram\ImagePath

rows.name: COM Hijacking via TreatAs
rows.description: Detect modification of TreatAs key to enable "rundll32.exe -sta" command
rows.logic:
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_*
filter_misexec:
  Image:
  - C:\Windows\system32\msiexec.exe
  - C:\Windows\SysWOW64\msiexec.exe
filter_office:
  Image|endswith: \OfficeClickToRun.exe
  Image|startswith: C:\Program Files\Common Files\Microsoft Shared\ClickToRun\
filter_office2:
  Image:
  - C:\Program Files\Microsoft Office\root\integration\integrator.exe
  - C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Office\root\integration\integrator.exe
filter_svchost:
  Image: C:\Windows\system32\svchost.exe
selection:
  TargetObject|endswith: TreatAs\(Default)
